description: Deactivate and reactivate rules: status change, last-admin guard, session and Voice ID side effects.

cases.log: Audit row UserDeactivated (details { email, isActive: false }); Voice ID ended (reason AccountDeactivated); calendar shares stopped; log "Account {UserId} deactivated by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Two active administrators exist; target is an active non-administrator with an enrolled Voice ID and Effective calendar shares.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11) with IsActive false; the row is kept; every refresh token and reset link of the account are revoked after the commit.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Target is an active account without an enrolled Voice ID.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11); no Voice ID log entry because nothing was enrolled.

cases.log: Audit row UserReactivated (details { email, isActive: true }); log "Account {UserId} reactivated by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Target is a deactivated account.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11) with IsActive true; no session is revoked, Voice ID is not restored and no share restarts.

cases.inputs: id: <random Guid with no account>; isActive: false.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.

cases.inputs: id: the actor's own id; isActive: false.
cases.log: Log "Status change rejected: administrator {ActorId} aimed at their own account."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12); the administrator stays active.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Target is already active.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12): a repeated request is refused so the audit log does not record the same change twice.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Target is already deactivated.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12); no second audit row.

cases.inputs: id: target (sole active administrator); isActive: false.
cases.log: Warning log "Status change rejected: deactivating {UserId} would leave no active administrator."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The target is the only active holder of AdminUsers (the actor acts with a still-valid token of an account that is no longer counted).
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12); the target stays active.

cases.inputs: id: B; isActive: false (requested with A's still-valid access token).
cases.log: Warning log "Status change rejected: ... would leave no active administrator."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Exactly two active administrators A and B; A has already been deactivated by B.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(StatusChangeNotAllowed) (MSG12): the last-administrator rule blocks mutual deactivation.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Two active administrators; the target is one of them.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11): another active administrator remains.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Target is an inactive account holding the AdminUsers role; the only active administrator is the actor.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11): reactivation is never blocked by the last-administrator rule.

cases.log: Error log "Account {UserId} was changed, but ending its sessions failed."; audit row UserDeactivated.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Ending the sessions fails (Redis unavailable) after the commit.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG11): the failure is logged, not raised.

precondition: At least two active administrators exist for the guard cases.
